propositions: Minor release 0.12.0 must be cut from main and published to PyPI, GitHub, MCP Registry, and Homebrew following the releasing.md workflow with all version files in lockstep.
CHANGELOG [Unreleased] section containing curated entries must be retitled to [0.12.0] - 2026-08-15 with a fresh [Unreleased] section and updated compare links.
All preflight guards and tests must pass: version-lockstep validation, lint, typecheck, full test suite, build, and twine checks before Gerrit submission.
Release commit must receive Gerrit LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with no unresolved comments, then be submitted to main.
release.yml workflow dispatched from main with version=0.12.0 must complete all 10 jobs successfully with pypi environment approval.
Published artifacts must be verified on PyPI (including PEP 740 attestation), GitHub tag/release, MCP Registry, and Homebrew, then validated via channel smoke test with probe_rebar.py.
